Bagi maksud caj perkhidmatan penumpang—

(a) "Penumpang Asal-Destinasi" ertinya seseorang penumpang yang berlepas

dari suatu lapangan terbang di Malaysia yang bukan seorang

Penumpang Pindahan;

(b) "Penumpang Pindahan" ertinya mana-mana penumpang yang memegang

satu tiket penumpang yang dijadualkan untuk berlepas dari suatu

lapangan terbang di Malaysia dalam masa dua puluh empat jam dari masa

ketibaan yang dijadualkan baginya ke suatu lapangan terbang lain di

Malaysia atau suatu negara lain selain lapangan terbang dari mana

penumpang tersebut berlepas—

(i) dalam sesuatu pesawat udara yang berlainan yang penumpang

tersebut tiba di lapangan terbang di Malaysia; atau

(ii) dalam pesawat udara yang sama yang penumpang tersebut tiba di

lapangan terbang di Malaysia tetapi dengan nombor penerbangan

yang berlainan;

yang dikendalikan oleh syarikat penerbangan yang sama atau yang

berlainan.".

Dibuat 23 Mei 2024

[MAVCOM/LSU/(R)/2024/002; PN(PU2)735/JLD.4]

DATUK SERI HJ. SARIPUDDIN HJ. KASIM

Pengerusi Eksekutif

Suruhanjaya Penerbangan Malaysia

MALAYSIAN AVIATION COMMISSION ACT 2015

MALAYSIAN AVIATION COMMISSION (AVIATION SERVICES CHARGES)

(AMENDMENT) REGULATIONS 2024 (AMENDMENT) REGULATIONS 2024

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 46 and subsection 98(1) of the

Malaysian Aviation Commission Act 2015 [Act 771], the Commission makes the

following regulations:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Malaysian Aviation Commission

(Aviation Services Charges) (Amendment) Regulations 2024 (Amendment)

Regulations 2024.

(2) These Regulations come into operation on 1 June 2024.

Substitution of paragraph 3

2. The Malaysian Aviation Commission (Aviation Services Charges) (Amendment)

Regulations 2024 [P.U. (A) 115/2024] are amended by substituting for paragraph 3

the following paragraph:

"Substitution of Second Schedule

For the purposes of passenger service charges—

(a) "Origin-Destination Passenger" means a passenger who departs from an

airport in Malaysia that is not a Transfer Passenger;

(b) "Transfer Passenger" means any passenger who holds a single passenger

ticket that is scheduled to depart from an airport in Malaysia within

twenty-four hours of their scheduled time of arrival for another airport in

Malaysia or another country other than the airport from which they

departed—

(i) on a different aircraft by which they arrived at the airport in

Malaysia; or

(ii) on the same aircraft by which they arrived at the airport in

Malaysia but with a different flight number;

operated by the same or a different airline.".

Made 23 May 2024

[MAVCOM/LSU/(R)/2024/002; PN(PU2)735/JLD.4]
